description: Open times on the Tabflows demo calendar, grouped by meeting length, soonest first. Every start time is a UTC ISO timestamp, whatever timezone is passed. An answer lists at most 20 times per meeting length: start sets a later date to read from, such as next week, and when truncated is true, nextStart is the start that returns the times after the cut. timezone is the person's IANA timezone: a start date is read in it, it picks the month monthOffset counts from, and the same timezone passed to book_demo sets the time zone of the booking and the invitation. A start time can be booked only with the durationMinutes it is listed under. Availability changes between calls, so times from an earlier answer may no longer be open.

monthOffset.description: Month to start reading at: 0 for this month (the default), 1 for next month, 2 for the one after

start.description: Earliest time to list: a YYYY-MM-DD date read in timezone, or the nextStart of an earlier answer. Defaults to now.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the times are read in, e.g. "America/New_York"

name: get_demo_availability
title: Get open Tabflows demo times
